Here is the distinction behind “unlimited MCP”:

What you do	Which allowance applies
Codex reasons, writes code, and decides what to do	Your Codex allowance through ChatGPT
Codex uses basic Aura MCP tools, such as inspecting assets	No Aura premium credit for those tools
Codex invokes Aura’s specialized Blueprint or Python agents	Aura premium credit is consumed
Aura documents those specialized-agent charges even when an outside assistant starts the task. Unlimited MCP doesn’t make all the AI work unlimited.

1. List the actual dirty and transient project-owned packages and their references.
2. Where an existing on-disk version is about to be overwritten, preserve that prior file and relevant sidecars in a small timestamped backup if accessible and space permits. Do not mistake that backup for preservation of memory-only objects.

I want Computer Use where supported. Determine whether this exact Windows client/session has a supported Computer Use tool or plugin. A screenshot obtained through Aura proves Aura's screenshot capability; it does not by itself prove general desktop control. YOLO permissions do not prove Computer Use exists. Keep file access, editor access, and desktop GUI access separate in the capability report.
Use native shell tools for terminal work. Do not automate ChatGPT itself or terminal applications through Computer Use. Do not disable Windows locking/security to keep working. If GUI access is blocked by a locked desktop, log the limitation and continue non-GUI work that remains available.
